form_title: Financial Campaign Report for County and Local School Board Candidates

reports.notes: Typed fillable form, scanned. The whole Address row (street, City, State, Zip) is a single black bar - redacted upstream by the county - so residence_city is '' rather than blank-by-filer. The Signature box is likewise a black bar; the Date box reads 04/04/2022 and the footer 'Date of Report' block also reads 04/04/2022, Page 1. The v. 4.20 form misprints the affirmation block's label as a second 'Type of Report' header - that is the blank form's own typo, not a filer error. Boxes B-F and the close line carry a printed '$' which is retained in totals_verbatim and dropped in the normalized totals. The summary page's letterhead names 'Amelia Powers Gardner, Clerk/Auditor' while page 1's names 'Josh Daniels' - the filing was assembled from two form vintages.

notes: The locator flagged pages 7 and 9 as summary pages; page 9 is NOT a second report - it is the Elections Division's internal 'CAMPAIGN FINANCIAL DISCLOSURE CHECKLIST' (two staff-review passes, Staff Signature #2 dated 4/4/2022). One report only.

contributions.anchor: Box B 'Contributions Received this Period' = $1975.00 on the p7 Summary Page, which is also Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page $ 1975.00' and its printed 'Total Contributions Received (Sum of all Schedule A pages in this report) $ 1975.00'
contributions.detail: 8 Schedule A rows on PDF p3 (the filer's own 'Page 2'): 50.00 + 100.00 + 250.00 + 1,000.00 + 25.00 + 50.00 + 400.00 + 100.00 = 1,975.00 EXACTLY, equal to all three printed figures. Box C year-to-date prints the same $1975.00 because this is the cycle's first report; the cumulative cell is still not summed as an increment. The grid holds 15 printed rows of which 7 are empty (crop-proved), so there is no second Schedule A sheet. THREE OF THE EIGHT ROWS ARE THE CANDIDATE'S OWN LOANS to his campaign, and they are itemized contribution rows here BY THE LADDER, not by their wording (§B3): Box A is 0.00, leaving no beginning-balance slot, and the schedule's own subtotal counts all three — without them the side would fall 1,150.00 short of every printed figure.

expenditures.anchor: Box D 'Expenditures Made this Period' = $1725.43 on the p7 Summary Page, which is also Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page $ 1725.43' and its printed 'Total Expenditures Made $ 1725.43'
expenditures.detail: 15 Schedule B rows on PDF p5 (the filer's own 'Page 3') fill the grid exactly: 12.00 + 37.55 + 16.95 + 241.62 + 10.16 + 61.07 + 400.00 + 60.83 + 6.43 + 3.14 + 43.58 + 5.20 + 300.00 + 425.00 + 101.90 = 1,725.43 EXACTLY = the printed page subtotal = the printed total = the promoted per-period Box D. Box E year-to-date prints the same figure. The cover ladder is internally consistent: F $1975.00 = A 0.00 + B $1975.00, and the close $249.57 = F - D.

itemized.in_kind_convention: not applicable and tested anyway — the `v. 4.20` blank used here has no in-kind column and no checkbox, and no row on either schedule carries an in-kind marker, so monetary-only and monetary-plus-in-kind give identical sums and both close (1,975.00 / 1,725.43). Tested on this filing rather than carried over from this filer's other 2022 report.
itemized.escalation_note: No cell needed escalation: both schedules are born-digital fillable-form text printed and re-scanned at good quality, and every proof crop rendered its figure unambiguously at 900 dpi. Confidence stays 'medium' because the retained artifact is a page image (SCHEMA §6).

itemized.notes: PAGE-FACE IDENTITY: 'Russ J Rampton' in the Name of Candidate box, on the affirmation line and on all three inner sheets, where index.csv's channel label is 'Russ Rampton' — the page face carries the middle initial and governs; the divergence is recorded, not resolved. The Office box prints 'County Clerk' (not 'Utah County Clerk'), agreeing with index.csv. Report type ticked 'Seven days preceding Convention'; amendment answered 'No'; Date of Report 04/04/2022 on the cover and on every inner sheet. FORM: `v. 4.20` blank (five report types, 'Address and Zip Code' column, no in-kind column, close box UNLETTERED), born-digital fillable and typed, printed and re-scanned. THE PDF IS A DUPLEX SCAN (§J3): 10 PDF pages = 5 physical sheets, every odd page a report page and every even page a genuinely blank verso — all five versos were read full-page and are blank. The filing's own foliation is a plain sequence 1, 2, 3, 4 on the four report pages, so the fifth sheet (PDF p9) is the clerk's CAMPAIGN FINANCIAL DISCLOSURE CHECKLIST and not part of the report. Page classification was done from each page's own printed header: PDF p1 cover, p3 Schedule A, p5 Schedule B, p7 SUMMARY PAGE, p9 checklist. THE CHECKLIST is the HOLD / 'Staff Signature #1' / '#2' revision with none of the Website / Network / HOLD boxes ticked; the red review copy is signed but its Date Reviewed line is LEFT BLANK, while the purple copy is dated 4/4/2022 — an honest blank in a clerk work product, recorded because the two review copies differ. It carries no dollar figures and is not a summary page. TWO MASTHEAD VINTAGES ALTERNATE SHEET BY SHEET inside this one filing (§L6): 'Josh Daniels Clerk/Auditor' on pp1 and 5, 'Amelia Powers Gardner Clerk/Auditor' on pp3 and 7. REDACTION: the county blacked out the candidate's whole cover address row and his signature, and the STREET portion of every one of the eight donor addresses on Schedule A, leaving city, state and zip legible in every case — a consistent per-cell practice on this filing, unlike others in this chunk where one row's city was also covered. The candidate's phone and email are published in the clear on the cover and are deliberately not carried into this record. BOTH SIDES CLOSE TO THE CENT on their own printed subtotals, on the schedules' sum-of-all-pages totals and on the promoted per-period boxes. THREE OF EIGHT CONTRIBUTION ROWS ARE CANDIDATE LOANS (1,150.00 of the 1,975.00 total) and are published as contribution rows because the document's own ladder requires them. FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN passed on both sheets: every date cell holds a date, every name cell a person or organisation, every address cell a city/state/zip, every purpose cell a purpose. ROW-INDEX TRAPS screened on both sheets: first written entry on band 1 (crop-proved on each), no continuation line, no voided row, no banner line, no doubled band, and nothing below the last printed rule (crop-proved outside the grid on the FULL Schedule B sheet, where the risk is real). NOTE FOR THE COORDINATOR: this filing itemizes NO candidate filing fee, which the county's other 2022 filings all carry — consistent with a Convention-period report filed before the fee was paid, observed and not adjudicated, and in any case the filing fee is never used to corroborate anything (§E1/§F5/§L3).
